relative.statement: PerfMatch substantially improves target out-of-domain accuracy (about 78%) over the other methods on the slab dataset.

quote.text: The results improve substantially: out-of-domain accuracy is now 78%.

tables.notes: PerfMatch is labelled oracle: on the slab data it uses ground-truth slab ids as matches, and the paper calls ERM-PerfMatch an oracle with access to ground-truth perfect matches (that quote is from the Table 2 discussion). Baseline numbers for DANN, CDANN, MMD, C-MMD, CORAL and C-CORAL were computed by the authors with DomainBed implementations, so provenance is this_paper. The caption's "(0.0 )" in the ERM row is copied as printed. The paper has no sentence that names the metric as accuracy for Table 1 in so many words, so the metric quote is the "out-of-domain accuracy" sentence.
